text: Madrun is a Welsh figure whose article points to the fuller entry on Modron. Koch records her as the daughter of Gwerthefyr's father Gwrtheyrn and the mother of St Ceidiaw. This may reflect confusion in the transmitted pedigrees. It may also preserve her original status as a dynastic mother goddess who validated successive generations of kings in a recurrent conception myth. Two place names recall her: Carn Fadrun in Llyn, north Wales, and Garthmadrun in Brycheiniog.
objective: Document Madrun as a Welsh figure cross-referenced to Modron and a possible dynastic mother goddess.
key_results: Record her parentage and maternity per Koch.
Record the place names Carn Fadrun and Garthmadrun.
